name: brooksby-ops
description: Solopreneur OS — config-driven agents for solo consultants running their business in Notion, Gmail, Calendar, and Granola. Onboarding, daily check-in, meeting prep, meeting capture, Monday planner, Friday wrap, the Daybook snapshot, and a full content engine: wednesday-synthesis, draft-content, polish-and-score, mark-published, collect-metrics, and surface-humanizer. Plus build-voice, which builds a voice profile from dictated samples by the cut-don't-compose method, one register at a time. Optional content-vault hooks wire the planner, capture, and wrap into a local markdown vault.
